name: zanker-media-generation
description: Create and optimize SVG/raster media with provenance and explicit project purpose.

workflow.instruction: Specify art purpose, dimensions, platform, license requirements, alt text and style.
For simple original SVG run `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/media-svg.sh --project . --kind empty --out public/assets/empty.svg`.
For raster use an authorized image-generation provider, then optimize with `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/media-optimize.sh` if Sharp installed.
Record source/provider, license, final dimensions and visual review; do not fabricate media generation when provider unavailable.

fallback: Use procedural SVG or a documented asset brief when no image provider exists.
